ads_interstitial_gap_sec.description: Minimum seconds between interstitials (and after an app open ad).

ads_session_grace_sec.description: No interstitial during the first N seconds of a session.

ads_app_open_gap_min.description: Minimum minutes between app open ads.

ads_app_open_away_sec.description: Show an app open ad on resume after at least N seconds in background.

ads_app_open_cold_start.description: Show an app open ad on cold start (from the 2nd launch, only if it loads within 5 s).

ads_interstitial_after_export.description: Interstitial after a save is written back or saved as.

ads_section_every.description: Interstitial on every Nth exit from an editor section (min 1).

ads_detail_every.description: Interstitial on every Nth detail page (min 2).

ads_tab_every.description: Interstitial on every Nth bottom tab switch (min 2).

ads_native_every.description: Native ad every N rows in collection lists (min 4).

ads_collapsible_banner.description: Use a collapsible banner on detail pages.

review_min_moments.description: Ask for a Play review after N positive moments (save written, progress imported).
